messages:
Miguel (CS): quick pulse for this week's onboarding cohort — error-rate breakdown and top failing paths. overall error rate +1.8pp vs last week. main buckets: 5xx, client timeouts, and rate-limit rejections.

Raj (CS): thanks — can you paste the top endpoints and their contribution percentages?

Miguel (CS): sure, pasted small table below (rolled up across the 20 most active accounts):
```
/v1/generate           34% of errors — mostly 5xx (upstream OOM / grpc resets)
/stream/embed          19% — client-side timeouts at ~1.2s median
/client/run           14% — 429 spikes during lunch hours (US-EAST)
/v1/chat/respond      11% — intermittent 502s from model variant fallback
/auth/session         7%  — rate-limit hits during bulk onboarding jobs
other endpoints       15%
```

Sam (SRE): for /v1/generate are we seeing a correlation with model rollouts or quantized variant usage? any kernel-level OOM logs?

Nora (Eng): looked into the node logs — a few hosts hit CUDA OOM during ~30s window on Tue 10:42-11:12 UTC; affected pool=dedicated-gpu-4. fallback to cpu-quant caused 502s.

Miguel (CS): customer impact notes: two mid-market customers (Kestrel & BrightLane) saw elevated 5xx and retried heavily, pushing their spend up. Kestrel flagged renewal risk if not stabilized.

Raj (CS): flagged Kestrel CSM — Lina — looped in. Action items?

Sam (SRE): short-term: 1) roll affected hosts out of pool (DONE) 2) add temporary capacity to dedicated-gpu-4 (scale +2) 3) enable backpressure on /client/run for bulk jobs (rate limiter tweak).

Nora (Eng): medium-term: 1) pin rollout policy to stable-quant for high-throughput customers, 2) add OOM alert on per-pool 5xx surge (threshold=5% over baseline for 5m).

Miguel (CS): CS asks: can we get a granular timeline of when 5xx spikes occurred and which model variants were active? also a simple mitigation note I can share with Kestrel about retry/backoff and expected timeline.

Sam (SRE): will export timeline + affected host IDs by EOD and post here. tentative ETA 6pm PT.

Nora (Eng): I'll draft the mitigation blurb — recommend exponential backoff (jittered), cap concurrent sessions to 8 for Kestrel until we confirm capacity, and opt into dedicated-stable model for next 48h.

Miguel (CS): perfect. I'll send Kestrel the note and schedule a short sync. tagging OpsBot for follow-up reminder. :calendar:

OpsBot: Reminder set — follow up in 12 hours for export + customer comms. :white_check_mark:

Raj (CS): one more ask — can we track rate-limit bursts by origin IP range? those 429s on /client/run look botty and concentrated.

Sam (SRE): yes — adding origin IP histogram to the /client/run alert. will include a top-10 IP ranges in the export.

Miguel (CS): thanks team. I'll update the weekly health doc with these findings and the mitigation steps. closing thread once timeline is posted. :thumbsup:
